documentation.summary: Transcribe the notes of one melodic or polyphonic instrument into an editable MIDI track.
documentation.menu: Tools → Advanced Local Processing → Audio to MIDI (Basic Pitch)
steps: Select a recording of one instrument or a clean vocal melody.
Install Basic Pitch through Model Manager, choose Audio to MIDI (Basic Pitch), and run the selected passage.
Review the detected note count, accept to create a MIDI track, then audition and correct it through Window → Piano roll (beta).
limitations: Full mixes, reverberation and strong harmonics can produce missed or extra notes.
This mode creates discrete notes and estimated velocities, without pitch bends, instrument separation or rhythmic quantization.
Selections are limited to 30 minutes; GPU availability and speed depend on the authenticated runtime and machine.
